newsitem.title: USA: HOT STOCKS - U.S. Corporate Earnings.
newsitem.headline: HOT STOCKS - U.S. Corporate Earnings.

text.p: Shares jumped after the Texas company's quarterly loss narrowed sharply compared to last year. Cyrix lost $0.23 a share compared to a loss of $0.49 a share last year. Also, a source at Oppenheimer said the firm raised Cyrix's rating.
INTEGRATED DEVICE TECHNOLOGY INC off 1-3/4 to 12

The Santa Clara semiconductor company fell almost 13 percent in very heavy trading after it posted a third quarter loss of $0.55 a share compared to earnings last year of $0.42 a share on a fully diluted basis.

GE shares continued to rise in heavy traading after its profits, reported yesterday, topped $2 billion in the fourth quarter and $7.3 billion for the year. Growth was led at NBC Television, GE Capital Services, and its power systems.

Third quarter earnings of $0.13 a share, compared to $0.09 a share last year, sent the stock higher. The Pittsburgh networking company earned even more, $0.16 a share, for the quarter before special items.
Shares hit a new year high of 60-5/8 after the Nashville, Tennessee company said it earned $1.13 a share compared to $1.12 a share last year before merger costs.
